manifest: V4 cycle baseline and split freeze

official_index.geometry: rotation 0; 119 videos slide on y (portrait -> 16:9, window .316 H); 55 on x (45 at .316, 9 at .297, 1 at .562)

RetargetVid.label_type: human dense per-frame crop boxes (1:3 x-axis win .188, 3:1 y-axis win .593)

LIVE-YT-VC.label_type: human sparse boxes (1 annotator, ~30 frames/video, variable size); x axis only (win .316); no interpolated frames used

YouTubeHighlights.label_type: human = mturk soft votes (relative within video, 413 videos); weak = match_label (-1 = not reused, NOT human negative); unlabelled frames masked

split_status.RetargetVid used 001-030: exposed (earlier dev/confirm); not used in V4
split_status.RetargetVid dev2 031-100: reused validation (T2 dev) -> V4 E1/E2 decision set
split_status.RetargetVid confirm2 601-700: reused validation (T2 confirm, T5 confirm) -> V4 E1 confirmation; labelled 'reused', not independent
split_status.LIVE val 178: reused validation (T5 confirm3); not used for V4 decisions
split_status.LIVE train 1,622: H1 fit (4 scalars) and H2 train/dev fold (sha1 % 10 == 0)
split_status.YTH val 124 (Test*L, <=120 s): reused videos (T3/T4 with weak labels); V4 E3 dev with human votes
split_status.YTH train 130 (Trai*L, human votes, veri: fresh for V4 E3 confirmation (records sha 081ebceb...; no group overlap with val)

rules: official test only through frozen policies (no training, no per-video tuning); one main change per package; unknown official scores null
